title: 第5章 仙骨震道域圣人老祖现身第6章 神子我儿有大帝之资
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
在顾清秋傻眼的时候。
顾长歌此时已经回了第一序列府房间。
端坐床榻之上，顾长歌看着眼前的信息，面露期待和一丝兴奋：“这一趟收获巨大，没想到不仅绑定一个重生女至尊族妹，还返还获得了仙骨，牛逼了！”
虽然不知道仙骨究竟有多牛逼，但沾染一个仙字，什么东西都会变得惊天动地，不凡至极。
要知道。
三千道域古往今来的帝境强者，哪个不是在追逐仙的脚步，如今他却获得了一枚仙骨。
【宿主亿万倍返还仙骨，是否开始融合？】
【是否！
顾长歌看着眼前信息，几乎就要确认了，不过下一秒他念想一顿，看了眼周围。
不用想。
融合仙骨这等无上机缘，必定会引起惊天动地的动静。
他有两种选择。
第一遮掩异象融合。
让父亲顾青出手，必定可以遮掩异象，继续沉淀自身。
仙骨来由随便编排一下就好了。
毕竟这方世界，哪怕是转世重修都不会奇怪，凭空诞生仙骨，说一直于身中酝酿也可。
第二就是。
如今他身具重瞳，贵为第一序列，如果再引出仙骨动静，恐怕后面的那些序列，以及站在序列背后的人会更加忌惮自已，而且敌对势力恐怕也会将自已视为眼中钉，肉中刺，立于危墙之下。
但这个顾长歌仅仅犹豫刹那，便选择第二种了。
开玩笑。

自已可是挂壁，而且还身具重瞳，长生世家第一序列，如若有仙骨这种资质还隐藏起来，那干脆别修炼了，当个苟王吧。
让自已资质变得更逆天，以自身地位，不仅不会有任何明面上的危险，甚至会得到更多的器重。
想到这里，顾长歌没有犹豫，直接心中一动对系统道：“系统，我要融合仙骨！”
在顾长歌话音落下刹那。
“嗡——”
一股莫名的神圣超脱气息，从他端坐床榻的身躯上一闪而逝。
他胸口犹如有一团仙光酝酿，开始透过血肉，肌肤，绽放莹莹光辉。
刹那间。
整个长生顾家被一股神秘气息笼罩，犹如一尊神圣驾临。
几乎在这股气息出现刹那，长生顾家万里族地内，一道道恐怖的双眸缓缓睁开，强盛的气息随处复苏，随即便化作一道道神光冲天而起。
这是一尊尊修为达到羽化境，乃至王者境的长生顾家族老。
他们屹立晴空之下，四处张望，神魂震动交流。
“怎么回事，发生了什么？这股气息……怎么让我有种惊悚的感觉。”
“从哪里散开来的，古怪，为什么一点异象都不见。”
“难道又是我长生顾家哪位真龙子即将觉醒了吗？”
一众族老神念震动交流。
一些长生顾家子弟，亦是震惊望着天穹。
因为他们从来没有看过，一下子出现这么多家族族老，要知道这些族老位高权重，修为超绝。
除了族内核心天骄，亦或者高层之外，平日都难以一见。
今日竟然惊动这么多。
content_en:
When Gu Qingqiu was dumbfounded.
Gu Changge had already returned to the first row of rooms at this time.
Sitting on the bed, Gu Changge looked at the information in front of him, with anticipation and a hint of excitement on his face: "This trip has yielded a huge harvest. I didn't expect that not only would I be bound to a reborn female Supreme Clan girl, but I would also get immortal bones in return, which is awesome!"
Although I don’t know how awesome the Immortal Bone is, if it is contaminated with an Immortal Character, anything will become earth-shattering and extraordinary.
To know.
Among the three thousand Dao Realm's ancient and modern emperor-level experts, who are not chasing the footsteps of immortals, but now he has obtained an immortal bone.
[The host returns the immortal bones billions of times, will the fusion begin? 】
【whether!
Gu Changge looked at the information in front of him and almost confirmed it, but the next second he thought about it and looked around.
No need to think.
Such an unparalleled opportunity as merging immortal bones will definitely cause earth-shattering news.
He has two options.
The first covering vision fusion.
Let his father Gu Qing take action, and he will be able to cover up the vision and continue to settle himself.
Just arrange the origin of the fairy bones casually.
After all, in this world, even reincarnation and rebuilding would not be surprising. Immortal bones are born out of thin air, and it can be said that they have been brewing in the body.
The second is.
Now that he has double eyes, he is the first rank. If he brings out the movement of immortal bones again, I am afraid that those behind him and those standing behind the rank will be more wary of him, and the hostile forces may also regard him as a thorn in their side, a thorn in their flesh, and stand under a dangerous wall.
But Gu Changge only hesitated for a moment before choosing the second option.
joke.
He is hanging on the wall, and he has double pupils. He is in the first rank of the Immortal Family. If he has the talent of immortal bones and still hides it, then he might as well stop practicing and become a Gou King.
Let your qualifications become more incredible, and with your own status, not only will there be no apparent danger, but you will even get more respect.
Thinking of this, Gu Changge did not hesitate, and directly said to the system with a thought in his heart: "System, I want to fuse the immortal bones!"
The moment Gu Changge finished speaking.
"Buzz——"
An inexplicable aura of divine detachment flashed from his body sitting upright on the bed.
It was as if there was a ball of fairy light brewing in his chest, and it began to bloom through the flesh and skin.
In an instant.
The entire Changsheng Gu family was shrouded in a mysterious aura, like a divine presence.
Almost at the moment when this aura appeared, within the Wanli clan of the Changsheng Gu family, terrifying eyes slowly opened, and the powerful aura revived everywhere, and then turned into streaks of divine light rising into the sky.
This is an immortal Gu family elder whose cultivation has reached the realm of Ascension and even the realm of kings.
They stood under the clear sky, looking around, their souls shaking and communicating.
"What's going on? What happened? This smell...why does it make me feel horrified?"
"Where did it come from? It's weird. Why can't I see anything strange at all?"
"Is it another true dragon son of my Changsheng Gu family who is about to awaken?"
A group of elder gods vibrated and communicated with each other.
Some of the Immortal Gu family members also looked at the sky in shock.
Because they have never seen so many family elders appear all at once. They must know that these clan elders have high positions and extraordinary cultivation.
Except for the core genius of the clan or the top management, it is difficult to see him on weekdays.
There were so many alarms today.
